vibe_rationale: Long-running, community-run DIY zine and small-press fair with a deep and welcoming scene, though small, single-scene and brand-free by design.
fit_notes: Niche zine and comics hobby crowd with little health relevance, and the fair takes no cash sponsors because it began as a protest against corporate sponsorship. Any role would be a light-touch community supporter rather than a partner, so the fit for a health brand is poor.
